note: First-party three.js ports built on site/games/arcade/kit.js. Files ship from the site repo; this manifest only tells the catalog they exist.

games.name: Sokoban
games.blurb: 10 hand-checked crate levels, 3D blocks, undo and push counter.
The classic, rebuilt in three.js with animated tiles and undo.

games.name: Mines3D
games.blurb: The F-Droid 3D minesweeper, rebuilt as a three.js board: flood reveal, flags, safe first click.

games.name: Brick Blast
games.blurb: The F-Droid brick breaker, rebuilt as a three.js court: 35 bricks, paddle bounce angles, waves.

games.name: Lichess
games.blurb: The Lichess board, rebuilt in three.js: click-or-tap chess against a built-in opponent, with check, mate, castling and undo.

games.name: Memory
games.blurb: The concentration card game, rebuilt in three.js: flip two cards, keep the pairs, four board sizes and a flip budget that can run out.

games.name: Checkers
games.blurb: The F-Droid checkers board, rebuilt in three.js: click-or-tap draughts against a built-in opponent, compulsory captures, chain jumps and three levels.

games.name: Sudoku
games.blurb: The F-Droid sudoku, rebuilt in three.js: click-or-tap boards in three levels, mistake counter, timer and win detection.

games.name: Flow
games.blurb: The connect-the-dots pipe puzzle, rebuilt in three.js: drag coloured pipes between matching dots, fill every cell, three puzzles.

games.name: Stone Wars
games.blurb: The F-Droid block puzzle, rebuilt in three.js: drag polyomino slabs onto a 10×10 field, clear full rows and columns for combos, and free each planet before the tray stops fitting.

games.name: Simon Tatham's Puzzles
games.blurb: The reference puzzle compendium, ported to three.js: Fifteen, Twiddle and Flood on one 3D board — slide, rotate and flood, all procedurally scrambled.

games.name: Open Chaos Chess
games.blurb: The F-Droid chaos variant, rebuilt in three.js: tap a piece and the board picks one of its legal moves at random, for both sides. No check, no castling — take every enemy piece to win, with a bloodthirst mode and a knights-only board.

games.name: Scid on the Go
games.blurb: The Android chess database, rebuilt as a three.js game viewer: four short games in the database, step or auto-play through them, tap any move in the list to jump straight to that position, and flip the board.

games.name: Flowit — Block Puzzle
games.blurb: The F-Droid grid puzzler, rebuilt in three.js: every cell must end the colour of its border, and each tap pushes a block's colour outward — arrows in one direction, a flood through its own colour, or a bomb into the ring around it. Six hand-tuned levels, all proven solvable.

games.name: Mahjong Scoring Compass
games.blurb: The Riichi score compass, rebuilt as a three.js table: tap a seat for the winner and the discarder, set han and fu, and it pays the hand — dealer repeat, honba, riichi sticks, wind rotation and final standings over a full hanchan.

games.name: Matrix Puzzle
games.blurb: The F-Droid logic-grid puzzle, rebuilt in three.js: six flats of three, four or five floors, three categories each, and a clue list that fits exactly one arrangement. Pick a chip, tap a floor, and every clue turns green or red as you go.

games.name: Go 9×9
games.blurb: A nine by nine goban in three.js: tap or click an intersection and the machine answers. Real capture, ko and suicide rules with area scoring, pass, undo and resign.

games.name: Gomoku
games.blurb: Fifteen by fifteen, click-or-tap five in a row against a heuristic opponent with undo and a last-move marker.

games.name: Block World
games.blurb: The Minetest sandbox rebuilt as a three.js voxel island: tap to mine blocks into your pack, build mode puts them back, and sand marks the gold seams you have to dig out before the pickaxe dulls.

games.name: Bagatur Chess Engine
games.blurb: The F-Droid chess engine rebuilt as a three.js board: play the built-in engine across five strength tiers (800 to 2200 Elo), ask for a gold-marked hint, watch the live eval, and undo straight back to your move.

games.name: Go To Sleep
games.blurb: The count-sheep ritual as a three.js night pasture: tap or click and the next sheep vaults the fence, every count refills the sleepiness meter, and 20 quiet sheep put you under — let the meter run dry and the flock wanders off.

games.name: Binary Puzzle
games.blurb: The F-Droid Takuzu, rebuilt in three.js: three 6x6 boards, tap-to-cycle cells, live rule checking and a three-slip limit.

games.name: Club Maze
games.blurb: Slides-until-a-wall maze: tap, swipe or use the arrows to stop on every gold ring inside par.

games.name: Chess Clock
games.blurb: Two 3D clocks on one body: tap a side to press it, your time stops and theirs starts, five controls from 1+0 bullet to 25+10 Fischer with the increment banked on every press, flag detection and a restart.
